description: This file defines the AccessFlowStateMachineService class, which manages workflow state transitions, allowed actions, and related operations for a Human Resource Management System. It interacts with the AccessFlowStateMachineDao data access object to retrieve and persist workflow state data, handle role-based permissions, and cache certain query results.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manage workflow state transitions, retrieve allowed actions, and handle role-based permissions within the HRM workflow system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the DAO responsible for database operations related to workflow state machines.

methods.name: setAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO object responsible for database operations.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of actions permitted for a given workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Fetches allowed workflow items, using cache to optimize repeated calls.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a specific action is permitted in the current workflow state for a given role.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Determines the next state in the workflow transition for given parameters.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Retrieves all allowed recruitment application states for a given workflow and role.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Returns states where actions can be performed, filtered by workflow, role, and actions.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Fetches all workflow state machine records for a specific workflow and optional role.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Persists a single WorkflowStateMachine record.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecordAsArray
methods.description: Persists an array of WorkflowStateMachine records.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific workflow state machine record based on workflow, state, role, action, and resulting state.

methods.name: getAllowedCandidateList
methods.description: Placeholder method to retrieve candidate list for a role (implementation pending).

methods.name: getAllowedProjectList
methods.description: Placeholder method to retrieve project list for a role (implementation pending).

methods.name: getAllowedVacancyList
methods.description: Placeholder method to retrieve vacancy list for a role (implementation pending).

methods.name: getAllowedCandidateHistoryList
methods.description: Placeholder method to retrieve candidate history for a role (implementation pending).

methods.name: getWorkflowItem
methods.description: Retrieves a specific WorkflowStateMachine item by ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkflowStateMachine item based on workflow, state, action, and role.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Deletes all workflow records associated with a specific user role.

methods.name: handleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Updates workflow records following a user role rename.

methods.name: resetWorkflowCache
methods.description: Clears cached workflow items to ensure consistency.
